agyos_skill.instructions: The **conversion bridge** — turn reach into clicks and an **owned audience**. The agent designs the strategy and post copy; **scheduling-and-queue → WoopSocial** publishes the driving posts and places links where supported; the **hub, landing page, and email tool are external.** A platform *rents* you attention and can change the rules tomorrow; your **audience is the thing you own.** The bio link's real job is converting reach into an **owned list** (email/SMS/community) that survives algorithm shifts — it's a **revenue engine or a leak** (optimized profiles convert ~10–15% of visitors). Most accounts waste it on a **homepage or link-graveyard**; the top move is the opposite of variety — **one clear action**, a **value-first capture** (lead magnet → email) **before** any sale, and the **right link placement per platform** (because several suppress in-post links). 1. **brand-profile** — positioning/offer. 2. **goals-and-kpis** — the **conversion goal** the link must serve. (Depth: `references/the-click-framework.md`.) - **C — Capture an owned audience:** lead magnet → email **before** the sale; the goal is a list you own. - **L — Lead to ONE clear action:** focus beats variety; kill the homepage/link-graveyard; match the action to the content's intent. - **I — Intent-match the destination per platform:** IG → lead magnet; X → one specific page; YouTube → more substance; LinkedIn → booking/lead capture. - **C — Carry the link correctly per platform:** **X/LinkedIn/Facebook → first comment**; **IG/TikTok → bio + Stories sticker + verbal CTA**; **Pinterest → link-out**; **YouTube → description + pinned comment**. - **K — Keep it tracked + fresh:** branded short link + **UTM + GA4**; A/B the top hub; rotate weekly, audit monthly; **never fabricate** a conversion. Rented-vs-owned; revenue-engine-or-leak; the homepage/link-dump mistake; capture-before-sell; the per-platform placement table + link suppression; destination-by-intent; branded short links + UTM + GA4; the bio link as A/B sandbox; living-document cadence: `references/traffic-2026-reality.md`.
